extracted.name: Sticky Popcorn
extracted.description: This sticky popcorn is made by melting marshmallows, butter, and brown sugar in the microwave, then pouring it over popped kernels for a sweet snack.
instruction_lines: Combine marshmallows, butter, and brown sugar in a microwave-safe bowl. Heat in the microwave until marshmallows are melted and mixture is smooth, 30 to 60 seconds.
Place popcorn in a large serving bowl. Pour marshmallow mixture over popcorn; stir to coat.
